'''Merboy Jedi's the penguins of Hoth (EBO deck)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Merboy]]
* '''Published:''' 7 March 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)|Hoth-L-hothmainpowergenerators.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 Hoth Main Power Generators (1st M.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

EBO with heavy space and heavy mains with a new trick to stop heavy drain decks at one location and a few old tricks long forgotten

The published list has 65 cards.

== Strategy ==

During your first turn put out a tragedy has occured and Don’t do that again dig for a vergance of the force when they are about to drain you big and you can reduce it down to 1 for the rest of the game for the most part.

Build up in space to get your drains and consolidate the people you used to get Ebo out at the hoth docking bay and deploy more people there like you are going to do an assualt through a docking bay transfer. Instead you are actually going to Nabrun Liebs over and kill them if they aren’t playing Imperial Arrest order which only about half the people seem to be playing anymore or less.

Noble sacrifice when the option proves worthwhile, keep battles going with savrip and order to engage. Play smart don’t leave yourself open for a beating.

Very effective against ground decks that fortify a location in one spot like most are *cough* Theed palace Jedi junk. With its high drains in space and ability to hold it shouldn’t have much trouble with anything.
